paras_en: The August inflation data in the United States has almost cemented expectations that the Federal Reserve will raise rates by one quarter point next week, giving a bit of certainty to the market after the early‑September decline in US stocks. However, the rate‑hike question being settled does not mean the market has escaped trouble; high oil prices, US Treasury yields, weakening consumer spending and whether corporate earnings can keep growing remain the main challenges before year‑end.

Dell Technologies (DELL‑US) surged 12% on Friday the 11th after RBC Capital Markets initiated coverage of the computer maker, assigning it an above‑average rating and a target price of $640. Dell’s stock has already jumped more than four‑fold this year, and the veteran PC manufacturer has become one of the main suppliers of Nvidia’s (NVDA‑US) platform servers and related equipment.

The core US Consumer Price Index (CPI) for August rose more than expected, sharply increasing pressure on Fed Chair Kevin Warsh to support a rate hike at next week’s policy meeting. Markets see the data as undermining the argument that inflation will cool on its own and making it difficult for Warsh to stay on the sidelines after delivering a tough anti‑inflation speech.

Global bond markets continued to face heavy selling on Friday the 11th, pushing the yield on the US 10‑year Treasury close to the closely watched 5% threshold. Oil prices breaking $100 a barrel, renewed inflation concerns and the heightened likelihood of a Fed rate hike as early as next week have led investors to reassess the trajectory of global interest rates.

A wave of mobile‑phone price hikes in the United States unexpectedly became a key driver of the August core CPI increase and could be the final straw that pushes the Fed to raise rates next week. The Bureau of Labor Statistics reported that the core CPI, which excludes food and energy, rose 0.3% month‑over‑month in August, above Bloomberg’s forecast of 0.2%. Wireless telephone service prices jumped 5.9% in a single month, the largest increase on record.

items.title: 葉門政府軍猛轟摩卡「殺戮區」 阻胡塞武裝逼近曼德海峽
items.title_en: Yemen Government Forces Bombard 'Killing Zone' in Mocha to Halt Houthi Advance Toward the Bab al-Mandab Strait
paras: 伊朗支持的胡塞武裝近日快速向葉門西南部推進，奪取重要港口城市摩卡，並宣稱已控制葉門整段紅海沿岸及曼德海峽周邊地區。獲沙烏地阿拉伯支持的葉門政府軍週五 (11 日) 表示，已對摩卡至曼德海峽之間的「殺戮區」展開猛烈空襲與轟炸，試圖遏止胡塞武裝繼續向南擴張。
《半島電視台》報導，葉門政府軍已撤出摩卡及其南方地區，包括佐巴卜市。胡塞武裝隨後占領當地空軍基地，並進一步向連接紅海與亞丁灣的曼德海峽推進。
胡塞武裝軍事發言人Yahya Saree 宣稱，該組織已將沙烏地支持的部隊逐出 6 個地區，全面掌握葉門紅海沿岸。他並表示，除沙烏地阿拉伯船隻外，其他航運公司的船舶仍可安全通行。
胡塞武裝近日也在社群平台發布照片及影片，聲稱已控制曼德海峽周邊，甚至進一步向南推進。當地記者指出，胡塞武裝仍有意擴張勢力，但目前尚未出現願意或有能力在地面阻止其推進的力量。
葉門政府軍發言人則表示，已開始對摩卡附近的「殺戮區」失守地帶展開猛烈空襲與轟炸。
這些失守地帶，範圍涵蓋摩卡至曼德海峽一帶，自 2017 年以來一直是政府軍抵擋胡塞武裝的重要防線，如今接連失守，可能大幅改變葉門內戰版圖。
胡塞掌握戰略咽喉 紅海航運風險升高
曼德海峽是連接紅海與亞丁灣的戰略水道，也是船舶往返蘇伊士運河、亞洲及歐洲的必經航線。胡塞武裝若能鞏固周邊控制權，即使不直接封鎖海峽，也可能憑藉岸基飛彈、無人機及小型船艇對航運施加更大壓力。
葉門南方過渡委員會外交事務代表Amr al-Bidh 表示，他先前已向西方外交官警告，國際社會需要制定全面性的國內、區域及國際策略因應胡塞武裝，零星空襲不足以阻止其擴張。
al-Bidh 指出，胡塞武裝進駐曼德海峽周邊後，即使不動用先進武器，也能直接影響航道安全，並可將飛彈等武器調往其他戰線。
聯合國也證實，胡塞武裝已接管摩卡一處人道援助設施。聯合國秘書長副發言人Farhan Haq 表示，相關工作人員已事先撤離，現場沒有聯合國雇員，所有人員均安全。他呼籲交戰各方保護人道工作人員、場所及資產。
沙烏地船隻遭點名 能源出口替代路線同步受阻
就在胡塞武裝宣布沙烏地船隻不再享有安全通行保證之際，沙烏地阿拉伯東西向輸油管線也因多次遇襲而預防性停運。這條管線將沙國東部產油區的原油輸送至紅海港口延布，是沙烏地避開荷姆茲海峽的主要出口替代路線。
沙烏地外交部表示，攻擊管線的無人機來自伊拉克境內。利雅德現階段決定暫不反擊，以便讓伊拉克政府採取措施，防止境內再被利用對沙烏地及鄰國發動攻擊。
伊拉克政府隨後確認，無人機從南部米桑省發射，已撤換當地軍事指揮官，並成立調查委員會追查幕後涉事者。
目前沒有證據顯示，這起輸油管線攻擊由胡塞武裝策動，因此兩起事件不能直接畫上等號。
不過，胡塞武裝控制葉門紅海沿岸，加上沙烏地避開荷姆茲海峽的主要輸油路線停擺，使紅海與荷姆茲海峽兩條能源運輸命脈同時承受壓力。
專家示警運輸風險恐轉化為通膨壓力
大西洋理事會全球能源中心資深研究員Ben Cahill 表示，東西向輸油管線是沙烏地避開荷姆茲海峽的主要替代選項，若長時間停運，將嚴重影響原油出口，進一步推升已經吃緊的全球能源市場壓力。
經濟學家Javed Hassan 指出，胡塞武裝推進造成的衝擊，不能只用實際減少多少原油供應衡量。更大的問題是替代航線、備用產能及物流調度空間遭到壓縮，使能源市場失去吸收突發事件的能力。
一旦市場認為紅海出口路線受到長期威脅，戰爭風險保費及船舶租金可能在貨物實際中斷前率先上漲，相關壓力也將由原油擴散至貨櫃航運、散裝運輸及其他商品，最終轉化為更廣泛的通膨衝擊。
外傳阿曼正推動海灣國家與伊朗高層週一在阿曼城市塞拉萊舉行會議，討論恢復荷姆茲海峽商業航運的協議，西德州原油期貨週五 (11日) 下跌 2.4%，收每桶 100.05 美元；布蘭特原油期貨下跌 2.8%，收每桶 104.61 美元。
儘管週五下跌，西德州原油本週仍累計大漲近 10%，布蘭特原油上漲近 9%。兩大指標油價本週均突破每桶 100 美元，兩週累計漲幅超過 18%。
paras_en: Iran-backed Houthi forces have recently surged southwestward in Yemen, seizing the key port city of Mocha and claiming control over Yemen's entire Red Sea coastline and the surrounding Bab al-Mandab area. The Saudi-backed Yemeni government forces said on Friday (the 11th) that they have launched heavy air strikes and bombings on the "killing zone" between Mocha and the Bab al-Mandab Strait in an effort to stop the Houthis from further southward expansion.

Al Jazeera reported that Yemeni government troops have withdrawn from Mocha and its southern environs, including the city of Zabab. Houthi fighters subsequently occupied the local air base and pushed further toward the Bab al-Mandab Strait that links the Red Sea with the Gulf of Aden.

Houthi military spokesman Yahya Saree claimed the group has expelled Saudi-backed forces from six districts and now fully controls Yemen's Red Sea coast. He added that, aside from Saudi Arabian vessels, ships from other shipping companies can still navigate safely.

The Houthis have also posted photos and videos on social media asserting they control the Bab al-Mandab area and are moving further south. Local journalists note the group still seeks to expand its influence, but no force currently appears willing or able to halt its ground advance.
A government spokesperson said heavy air strikes and bombings have begun against the lost “killing zone” near Mocha.

These lost zones, stretching from Mocha to the Bab al-Mandab, have served since 2017 as a crucial defensive line for government forces against the Houthis. Their recent collapse could dramatically reshape Yemen's civil‑war map.
Houthi Control of Strategic Choke Point Raises Red Sea Shipping Risks

The Bab al-Mandab Strait, a strategic waterway linking the Red Sea with the Gulf of Aden, is a vital corridor for vessels traveling between the Suez Canal, Asia and Europe. If the Houthis consolidate control around the strait, even without a full blockade, they could use shore‑based missiles, drones and small boats to increase pressure on shipping.

Amr al‑Bidh, the diplomatic affairs representative of Yemen’s Southern Transitional Council, said he had previously warned Western diplomats that the international community needs a comprehensive domestic, regional and global strategy to counter the Houthis, as sporadic air strikes are insufficient to stop their expansion.

Al‑Bidh noted that once the Houthis are present around the Bab al-Mandab, even without advanced weaponry they can directly affect the safety of the waterway and can redeploy missiles and other arms to other fronts.

The United Nations confirmed that the Houthis have taken over a humanitarian aid facility in Mocha. UN Secretary‑General deputy spokesperson Farhan Haq said staff had been evacuated in advance, no UN employees remain on site and all personnel are safe. He urged all parties to protect humanitarian workers, sites and assets.
Saudi‑Flagged Vessels Targeted as Alternative Energy Export Routes Also Disrupted

Just as the Houthis announced that Saudi ships would no longer enjoy safe‑passage guarantees, Saudi Arabia’s east‑west oil pipeline was put on preventive shutdown after multiple attacks. The pipeline carries crude from the kingdom’s eastern production fields to the Red Sea port of Yanbu, serving as Saudi Arabia’s main alternative export route that bypasses the Hormuz Strait.

Saudi Arabia’s foreign ministry said the drones that struck the pipeline originated from within Iraq. Riyadh has decided not to retaliate at this stage, allowing the Iraqi government to take measures to prevent its territory from being used for attacks on Saudi Arabia and neighboring states.

The Iraqi government later confirmed the drones were launched from the southern province of Maysan, has replaced the local military commander and set up an investigative committee to trace those responsible.
There is currently no evidence that the pipeline attack was orchestrated by the Houthis, so the two incidents should not be directly equated.

Nevertheless, Houthi control of Yemen’s Red Sea coast, combined with the shutdown of Saudi Arabia’s main alternative oil route that avoids the Hormuz Strait, puts simultaneous pressure on both the Red Sea and the Hormuz Strait as vital energy corridors.
Experts Warn Transport Risks Could Translate Into Inflationary Pressure

Ben Cahill, a senior researcher at the Atlantic Council’s Global Energy Center, said the east‑west pipeline is Saudi Arabia’s primary alternative to bypass Hormuz, and a prolonged shutdown would severely curb crude exports, further tightening an already strained global energy market.

Economist Javed Hassan pointed out that the impact of the Houthi advance cannot be measured solely by the volume of crude lost. A bigger issue is the compression of alternative routes, spare capacity and logistics flexibility, which erodes the market’s ability to absorb shocks.

If markets perceive a long‑term threat to Red Sea export routes, war‑risk premiums and vessel charter rates may rise before any actual cargo disruption occurs, spreading pressure from crude oil to container shipping, bulk transport and other commodities, ultimately feeding broader inflation.

Reports suggest Oman is facilitating a meeting on Monday in the Omani city of Salalah between Gulf states and senior Iranian officials to discuss restoring commercial navigation through the Hormuz Strait. West Texas Intermediate crude fell 2.4% on Friday (the 11th) to $100.05 a barrel, while Brent fell 2.8% to $104.61 a barrel.

Despite Friday’s decline, West Texas Intermediate has risen nearly 10% this week and Brent almost 9%. Both benchmark crude prices have broken the $100‑a‑barrel mark this week, with a two‑week gain of over 18%.

items.title: 傳輝達擬砸100億美元押注Anthropic！AI史上最大IPO估值上看2兆美元
items.title_en: Nvidia Mulls $10 B Bet on Anthropic! AI’s Largest IPO Valuation Could Reach $2 T
paras: 人工智慧新創Anthropic正與輝達(NVDA-US)洽談，考慮讓這家全球最具影響力的AI晶片製造商成為其超大型首次公開募股(IPO)的基石投資人。知情人士透露，Anthropic計畫在IPO中募資最高達1,000億美元，目標估值約2兆美元，而輝達考慮投入的資金最高可能達100億美元。相關討論仍在進行，最終條件、金額及時間表都可能改變。
若交易成行，輝達將成為Anthropic此次IPO的重要早期戰略投資人，不僅能替這場可能創下歷史紀錄的超大型上市案提供市場信心，也將進一步深化雙方已相當緊密的商業關係。Reuters指出，這場IPO將成為公開市場對前沿AI企業超高估值及龐大資本需求承受能力的一項重大測試。
所謂基石投資人，通常是指在IPO正式向更廣泛市場推介前，就承諾認購一定比例股票的機構投資人，藉此向其他投資人釋放對公司及發行價格的信心。隨著大型科技企業及AI新創的募資規模快速擴大，超大型IPO提前尋找基石投資人的做法也愈來愈普遍。先前晶片設計商Arm的基石投資人就包括輝達與亞馬遜，而SpaceX的基石投資人則包括沙烏地阿拉伯公共投資基金(PIF)。
Anthropic目前高度依賴輝達GPU提供AI模型訓練與推論所需的算力，但隨著Claude需求快速增加，公司也積極降低對單一晶片供應商的依賴。Anthropic已分別與亞馬遜及Google合作取得自研AI晶片算力，同時還開始組建內部硬體團隊，希望自行設計針對Claude最佳化的客製化晶片，以進一步控制硬體成本。
雙方的合作關係早已不僅限於晶片供應。2025年11月，輝達宣布將對Anthropic投資最高100億美元，並與Anthropic建立更廣泛的合作關係。在相關安排下，Anthropic承諾採購300億美元、由輝達晶片驅動的Microsoft Azure運算容量，顯示輝達正透過投資、晶片供應及雲端基礎設施形成更深的AI生態系合作。

Anthropic目前的主要投資人還包括亞馬遜(AMZN-US)與Google母公司Alphabet(GOOGL-US)，而這兩家公司同時也是Anthropic的重要算力供應商。4月，Anthropic宣布與亞馬遜擴大合作，未來10年將向Amazon Web Services(AWS)投入超過1,000億美元，並取得最高5GW的新運算容量，其中包括超過100萬顆Trainium2晶片，以及截至2026年底陸續上線的Trainium2與Trainium3算力。
Anthropic同時也與Google及Broadcom(AVGO-US)擴大合作，取得多GW的新一代TPU運算容量，預計自2027年開始陸續上線，用於支援Claude模型及全球客戶快速增加的需求。Anthropic表示，這是公司迄今最重大的算力擴充計畫之一。
Anthropic對算力的需求正在隨營收高速成長。公司2025年底的年化營收約90億美元，到2026年5月已突破470億美元，7月底更進一步超過650億美元。Reuters此前報導，這項年化營收數字是根據當前銷售速度推估全年表現，反映Claude商業化速度大幅加快。
Anthropic在今年5月完成650億美元H輪融資，投資人包括Altimeter Capital、Dragoneer、Greenoaks及Sequoia Capital，投後估值達9,650億美元。換言之，若此次IPO最終以約2兆美元估值完成，Anthropic的市場估值將在數個月內再度大幅翻升。
公司對未來營收的預期同樣極為激進。Reuters先前報導，Anthropic預估2028年營收可能達1,900億至2,000億美元，這項預測將是支撐其2兆美元潛在估值的重要依據之一。
若IPO依照目前規畫推進，預計將在11月美國期中選舉前完成。這意味著Anthropic可能成為今年全球資本市場最受矚目的上市案之一，也將與OpenAI等其他大型AI企業的潛在IPO形成直接比較。
AI新創的資本需求正在快速膨脹。OpenAI今年2月宣布規模達1,100億美元的融資，估值達8,400億美元，其中包括輝達300億美元、軟銀300億美元及亞馬遜500億美元的投資，顯示大型科技公司及資本市場正競相透過股權投資與算力合作卡位下一階段AI產業。
與此同時，Anthropic及OpenAI等前沿AI企業也正尋求在IPO後取得投資級信用評等，以降低未來發債及融資成本。金融機構預期，若這些企業能取得投資級評等，將有機會進一步進入規模達11.7兆美元的企業債市場，為資料中心、晶片採購及AI基礎建設提供額外資金來源。
Anthropic的IPO因此不只是單純的科技公司上市案，更牽動輝達、Google、亞馬遜、Broadcom及大型金融機構所建立的AI算力供應鏈。隨著前沿AI模型對GPU、TPU、資料中心、電力及雲端運算容量的需求同步攀升，Anthropic若以接近2兆美元估值上市，將成為資本市場衡量AI產業高估值能否由快速成長營收支撐的重要指標。
paras_en: AI startup Anthropic is in talks with Nvidia (NVDA-US) about making the world’s most influential AI chip maker a cornerstone investor in its mega‑initial public offering. Sources say Anthropic plans to raise up to $100 billion in the IPO, targeting a valuation of about $2 trillion, and Nvidia could commit as much as $10 billion. Discussions are ongoing and final terms, amounts and timing could change.

If the deal goes through, Nvidia would become a key early strategic investor in Anthropic’s IPO, bolstering market confidence in what could be a record‑breaking mega‑listing and deepening an already close commercial relationship. Reuters notes the IPO will be a major test of the public market’s appetite for frontier‑AI firms with sky‑high valuations and massive capital needs.

A cornerstone investor is an institution that commits to buying a set share of stock before the IPO is marketed to the broader market, signalling confidence in the company and its pricing. As fundraising scales for big‑tech and AI startups, seeking cornerstones ahead of ultra‑large IPOs is becoming routine. Earlier, chip designer Arm counted Nvidia and Amazon among its cornerstones, while SpaceX’s cornerstones include Saudi Arabia’s Public Investment Fund (PIF).

Anthropic currently relies heavily on Nvidia GPUs for the compute power needed to train and run its Claude models, but as demand for Claude surges the company is actively reducing dependence on a single chip supplier. Anthropic has partnered with Amazon and Google to secure custom AI‑chip capacity and is building an internal hardware team to design a Claude‑optimized chip, aiming to better control hardware costs.

The partnership goes beyond chip supply. In November 2025 Nvidia announced a potential $10 billion investment in Anthropic and a broader collaboration. Under the deal, Anthropic pledged to purchase $30 billion of Microsoft Azure compute powered by Nvidia chips, showing Nvidia is weaving deeper AI‑ecosystem ties through investment, chip supply and cloud infrastructure.

Anthropic’s other major investors include Amazon (AMZN-US) and Google parent Alphabet (GOOGL-US), both also key compute providers. In April Anthropic said it would expand its tie‑up with Amazon, committing over $100 billion to AWS over the next decade and securing up to 5 GW of new compute capacity, including more than 1 million Trainium 2 chips and additional Trainium 2 and Trainium 3 capacity slated to come online through the end of 2026.

Anthropic is also expanding cooperation with Google and Broadcom (AVGO-US) to obtain several gigawatts of next‑generation TPU capacity, expected to roll out from 2027 to support Claude and rapidly growing global demand. The company calls this its biggest compute‑expansion plan to date.

Anthropic’s compute needs are rising with its fast‑growing revenue. Annualized revenue was about $9 billion at the end of 2025, topped $47 billion by May 2026, and exceeded $65 billion by late July. Reuters previously reported that these annualized figures are extrapolated from current sales velocity, reflecting a sharp acceleration in Claude’s commercialization.

In May this year Anthropic closed a $65 billion Series H round, backed by Altimeter Capital, Dragoneer, Greenoaks and Sequoia Capital, valuing the company at $965 billion post‑money. In other words, if the IPO ultimately lands at roughly a $2 trillion valuation, Anthropic’s market cap would surge dramatically again within months.

The firm’s revenue outlook is equally aggressive. Reuters earlier reported Anthropic projects 2028 revenue of $190 billion to $200 billion, a forecast that underpins the potential $2 trillion valuation.

If the IPO proceeds as planned, it is expected to close before the U.S. mid‑term elections in November, making Anthropic one of the most watched listings of the year and a direct comparator to potential IPOs from other AI giants such as OpenAI.

AI startups’ capital needs are ballooning. OpenAI announced a $110 billion financing round in February, valuing it at $840 billion, with Nvidia, SoftBank and Amazon each contributing $30 billion, $30 billion and $50 billion respectively, illustrating how big‑tech firms and capital markets are racing to secure equity stakes and compute partnerships for the next AI wave.

At the same time, Anthropic, OpenAI and other frontier AI firms are seeking investment‑grade credit ratings after their IPOs to lower future borrowing and financing costs. Analysts say that if these firms achieve such ratings, they could tap the $11.7 trillion corporate bond market, providing extra funding for data centers, chip purchases and AI infrastructure.

Anthropic’s IPO is therefore more than a tech‑company listing; it pulls in Nvidia, Google, Amazon, Broadcom and major financial institutions that form the AI compute supply chain. As cutting‑edge AI models drive up demand for GPUs, TPUs, data‑center power and cloud capacity, a near‑$2 trillion‑valued listing would become a key barometer for whether the market’s lofty AI valuations can be sustained by rapid revenue growth.

items.title: AI需求旺！戴爾大漲12%獲RBC看好 今年飆升近350%
items.title_en: AI Demand Soars! Dell Jumps 12% as RBC Gives Bullish Outlook, Up Nearly 350% This Year
paras: 《CNBC》報導，戴爾科技(Dell Technologies)(DELL-US)股價周五(11日)大漲12%，此前RBC Capital Markets啟動對該電腦製造商的分析，並給予優於大盤的股票評級及640美元的目標價。
戴爾周五上漲之際，今年迄今股價已飆升超過4倍。這家老牌PC製造商已成為輝達(Nvidia)(NVDA-US)平台伺服器及相關設備的主要供應商之一，而雲端企業及各大企業正大量採購這些設備，以因應AI需求。
RBC分析師David Paige周四在報告中寫道，「在看不到成長放緩跡象的情況下，我們認為戴爾仍處於有利位置，可受惠於持續多年的AI基礎設施支出周期。」
RBC表示，戴爾目前伺服器積壓訂單金額達950億美元，尚未開始履行，而第二季AI伺服器銷售額則約為164億美元。
戴爾本月稍早公布的第二季財報優於市場預期，並將全年財測上調至1,920億美元，意味著營收較去年將大增近70%。
戴爾高層在財報電話會議上告訴投資人，由於記憶體等電腦零組件成本上升，公司正在提高產品價格，而這也是此次上調財測的因素之一。
戴爾是最早出貨輝達Grace Blackwell NVL72機櫃的企業之一，凸顯其與輝達的密切合作關係，以及取得輝達GPU供應的能力。戴爾也為CoreWeave等新興雲端服務商提供產品。
戴爾不採用輝達GPU的產品，例如儲存設備，也受惠於AI帶動的需求增加，最近一季儲存業務營收成長26%。RBC認為，對於希望建置AI基礎設施的企業而言，戴爾實際上可以提供一站式解決方案。
Paige寫道，「戴爾業界領先的供應鏈是一道競爭護城河，使公司在供應中斷期間脫穎而出。隨著客戶在供應波動或受限期間越來越依賴戴爾，尋求一個能夠『穩住局面』的合作夥伴，這項優勢將更加明顯。」。
7月期間，美國總統川普再次建議民眾購買戴爾電腦。川普自去年重返白宮後，便曾買進戴爾股票。
paras_en: CNBC reported that Dell Technologies (DELL-US) shares surged 12% on Friday (the 11th) after RBC Capital Markets initiated coverage of the computer maker, assigning it an outperform rating and a $640 price target.

As Dell rose on Friday, its stock has already climbed more than four‑fold this year. The veteran PC maker has become one of the main suppliers of Nvidia (NVDA-US) platform servers and related equipment, with cloud providers and large enterprises buying heavily to meet AI demand.
RBC analyst David Paige wrote in a Thursday note, "With no sign of a slowdown in growth, we believe Dell remains well positioned to benefit from a multi‑year AI infrastructure spending cycle."
RBC said Dell currently has a backlog of server orders worth $95 billion that has not yet been fulfilled, and AI server sales in the second quarter were about $16.4 billion.

Dell’s second‑quarter earnings released earlier this month beat market expectations and the company raised its full‑year revenue forecast to $192 billion, implying a near‑70% increase over last year’s sales.
During the earnings call, Dell executives told investors that rising component costs such as memory are prompting the company to raise product prices, which was one factor behind the higher forecast.

Dell was among the first firms to ship Nvidia’s Grace Blackwell NVL‑72 cabinets, highlighting its close partnership with Nvidia and its ability to secure Nvidia GPU supply. Dell also supplies emerging cloud providers such as CoreWeave.

Even Dell products that do not use Nvidia GPUs, such as storage systems, are benefiting from AI‑driven demand, with storage revenue growing 26% in the most recent quarter. RBC believes Dell can offer a one‑stop solution for enterprises building AI infrastructure.

Paige wrote, "Dell’s industry‑leading supply chain is a competitive moat that lets the company stand out during supply disruptions. As customers become more reliant on Dell during periods of supply volatility or constraints, seeking a partner that can ‘steady the ship,’ this advantage will become even more pronounced."
During July, former President Donald Trump again urged the public to buy Dell computers. Trump, who returned to the White House last year, has previously purchased Dell stock.

items.title: SpaceX再拿算力大單 千億美元年營收目標更近了
items.title_en: SpaceX Secures Another Massive Compute Deal, Bringing $100 Billion Annual Revenue Goal Closer
paras: 《MarketWatch》報導，SpaceX(SPCX-US)又簽下一筆人工智慧(AI)運算能力交易，讓公司距離雄心勃勃的營收目標更近一步。
長期擔任SpaceX財務長的Bret Johnsen周四(10日)在高盛一場會議上表示，公司本月稍早與一家未具名企業簽署AI算力合約。他指出，該合約自12月起每月價值11億美元，換算成年化營收約130億美元。
這筆交易將讓SpaceX更接近公司設定的目標，也就是在2026年底前達到1,000億美元的年化營收運行率(ARR)。企業通常會根據較短期間內的營運表現，推估未來一整年的營收，以此估算ARR。若達成1,000億美元目標，將較SpaceX僅幾個月前的水準大幅提升。
德意志銀行分析師Edison Yu估計，SpaceX第二季的年化營收運行率僅約310億美元。不過，他上月在一份報告中表示，1,000億美元的目標「很可能相當容易達成」，主要受惠於新型雲端服務商(neocloud)及SpaceX收購的一家新創公司Cursor所帶來的貢獻。
AI相關企業對算力的需求十分旺盛，而相較於整個產業的需求，目前運算能力供應仍然不足。根據PwC一份報告，直到2050年，全球預計將投入超過36兆美元建置算力。SpaceX、微軟及其他企業，也已將銷售及出租雲端算力發展成一項重要業務。
今年7月，SpaceX與一家未具名客戶簽署一筆67億美元、為期6個月的算力合約，多名分析師認為，該客戶可能是美國國防部。SpaceX另外也與Anthropic這家主要競爭對手、同時是競爭對手與SpaceX投資者的Alphabet，以及新創公司Reflection AI簽署多年期合約，提供運算能力。
根據相關文件，Anthropic已同意每月支付SpaceX 12.5億美元，合約將持續至2029年5月。Google則同意從下個月起至2029年6月，每月支付9.2億美元。
這些合約也存在一項值得注意的限制。Johnsen表示，SpaceX「幾乎所有，甚至可以說全部」的算力合約，都允許雙方在僅合作數個月後提前終止合約。因此，SpaceX可能在合約原定期限到期前，就失去這些價值數十億美元的交易。
不過，Johnsen表示，之所以允許提前終止合約，是因為SpaceX「對自身產品有信心」。這些產品本身也需要算力來進行推論與訓練。
Johnsen補充，「你不會希望因為把算力永久提供給別人，而在未來幾年反過來限制了自家產品的發展。」
paras_en: MarketWatch reports that SpaceX (SPCX-US) has signed another artificial intelligence (AI) compute capacity deal, moving the company a step nearer to its ambitious revenue target.

Long‑time SpaceX CFO Bret Johnsen told a Goldman Sachs conference on Thursday (the 10th) that the company earlier this month signed an AI compute contract with an unnamed firm. He said the contract is worth $1.1 billion per month starting in December, roughly $130 billion on an annualized revenue basis.

The deal brings SpaceX closer to its goal of achieving a $100 billion annualized revenue run‑rate (ARR) by the end of 2026. Companies typically extrapolate a full‑year ARR from performance over a shorter period. Hitting the $100 billion mark would be a huge jump from where SpaceX stood only a few months ago.

Deutsche Bank analyst Edison Yu estimates SpaceX’s Q2 ARR at about $31 billion. However, he wrote last month that the $100 billion target “is likely to be relatively easy to achieve,” driven mainly by contributions from a new cloud provider (neocloud) and Cursor, a startup SpaceX recently acquired.

Demand for compute from AI‑related firms is booming, while supply still lags overall industry needs. A PwC report projects that by 2050 the world will invest over $36 trillion in building compute capacity. SpaceX, Microsoft and other players have already turned selling and leasing cloud compute into a major business line.

In July this year, SpaceX signed a six‑month, $6.7 billion compute contract with an unnamed customer that several analysts think may be the U.S. Department of Defense. SpaceX also inked multi‑year deals with Anthropic—a major competitor and also an Alphabet investor—and the startup Reflection AI to provide compute services.
According to the agreements, Anthropic will pay SpaceX $1.25 billion per month through May 2029, while Google has agreed to pay $920 million per month from next month through June 2029.

These contracts contain a notable clause. Johnsen said that “almost all, if not literally all” of SpaceX’s compute agreements allow either party to terminate early after only a few months of collaboration, meaning SpaceX could lose deals worth billions before the original term expires.
Johnsen added that the early‑termination provision exists because SpaceX “has confidence in its own products.” Those products themselves require compute for inference and training.
He concluded, “You don’t want to lock up compute forever for others and then, in a few years, find it limits the development of your own products.”

items.title: 高盛科技大會收官！科技巨頭齊看多AI 黃仁勳曝2030年4兆美元商機
items.title_en: Goldman Sachs Tech Conference Concludes: Tech Giants Bullish on AI, Jensen Huang Forecasts $4 Trillion Opportunity by 2030
paras: 高盛科技大會於美西時間9月11日落幕，為期4天的會議期間，輝達、SpaceX、泛林集團及多家網路安全業者高層接連釋放對人工智慧(AI)產業的樂觀訊號，普遍認為AI基礎建設需求仍然強勁。不過，高盛銷售與交易團隊指出，投資人目前仍保持審慎，市場正等待AI巨額資本支出最終轉化為持續性的營收與獲利成長。
本屆高盛科技大會於9月8日在舊金山開幕，輝達執行長黃仁勳、SpaceX財務長Bret Johnsen等科技業高層於9月10日陸續登台。高盛銷售與交易團隊在會議最後一天總結表示，與前兩天相比，參與企業釋放的整體訊號仍然「堅定看多」，消費需求健康、企業需求穩定，晶片供需也持續偏緊，但投資人對重新全面押注AI基礎建設交易仍然猶豫。
黃仁勳的談話成為本屆大會焦點。他重申，預計到2030年，全球AI基礎設施年度支出將達到3兆至4兆美元，顯示AI運算需求可能在未來數年維持高速成長。
黃仁勳表示，AI並不是另一輪普通的科技週期，而是計算方式從「檢索式」向「生成式」轉變的根本性變革。他將AI資料中心形容為「AI工廠」，認為這類基礎設施正逐漸成為生產智能的新型資產。
隨著輝達業務快速成長，黃仁勳也指出，AI產業目前面臨的瓶頸已從單純的晶片供應，延伸至整個上下游供應鏈。上游包括先進封裝、DRAM與LPDDR記憶體、連接器、電壓調節器及晶圓等環節均面臨供應挑戰；下游則涉及土地、電力及資料中心廠房等資源。
不過，黃仁勳認為，輝達在供應鏈上下游仍具有優勢。公司上游擁有全球規模最大的供應鏈之一，下游則具備多元化銷售渠道，有能力將AI運算需求轉化為更大規模的產品及服務市場。
高盛交易團隊也指出，電力、記憶體、資料中心建設及產能等限制，可能讓AI算力供不應求的局面延續至2028年。換言之，即使AI伺服器需求持續增加，產業真正能夠部署多少算力，仍受到能源、土地、廠房及半導體供應等實體條件限制。
除了資料中心，黃仁勳也看好AI向機器人領域延伸。他預期，基於推理的機器人操作技術約兩年後可能迎來重大拐點，意味著AI推理能力進一步成熟後，機器人可能成為下一階段的重要AI應用市場。
對於市場近期對AI產業「循環融資」的質疑，黃仁勳則予以反駁。他表示，輝達投入的資金規模相對有限，但可以換取相當大的回報，而且公司能夠清楚看到被投資企業已經簽訂的訂單需求，因此不能將相關投資簡單視為「循環融資」。
SpaceX同樣對AI基礎建設市場抱持高度樂觀態度。SpaceX財務長Johnsen表示，公司正將自身定位為一體化AI基礎設施平台，預計2027年每GW算力可帶來300億至500億美元收入，目前已經處於該區間的上沿。
Johnsen並表示，SpaceX對今年底實現1000億美元年化總收入更有信心。公司預計到2026年底，總算力將超過2GW，並預估2027年底進一步達到5GW至10GW，同時計畫在2027年部署AI衛星。
這項規畫意味著SpaceX正試圖將太空、衛星通訊及AI運算資源整合，形成不同於傳統大型雲端服務商的AI基礎設施模式。隨著AI模型對運算能力及資料傳輸需求持續增加，衛星及太空基礎設施是否能成為AI產業下一階段的運算資源，也逐漸成為市場關注方向。
半導體設備商泛林集團(LRCX-US)的管理層同樣釋放強勁訊號。泛林財務長Doug Bettinger表示，半導體設備產業目前「基本處於售罄狀態」，管理層目前更擔心錯失市場上行機會，而不是準備應對下一輪下行週期。
Bettinger預期，2027年晶圓製造設備需求成長將主要由DRAM帶動，但潔淨室供應仍將是關鍵限制。隨著記憶體廠商擴大投資，新增潔淨室產能預計在2027年底前陸續投入使用，在此之前，設備供應可能持續受到產能限制。
AI熱潮也正在推動網路安全產業升溫。Palo Alto Networks(PANW-US)執行長Nikesh Arora表示，AI安全產業「甚至還沒有真正建立起來」，暗示隨著AI代理人、生成式AI及企業AI應用快速普及，相關安全市場仍處於早期階段。
CrowdStrike(CRWD-US)執行長George Kurtz則表示，AI並沒有排擠企業原有的網路安全預算，反而正在推動安全支出增加。他認為，企業的安全投入正從單純的防禦性支出，逐漸轉變為協助企業安全導入AI的必要基礎建設。
黃仁勳對網路安全熱潮則持較為保留的態度。他表示，近期市場高度關注網路安全，部分原因可能是業界即將推出新產品，存在一定程度的「製造需求」因素。不過，他仍認為網路安全很可能成為AI下一個主要應用場景。
黃仁勳指出，尋找軟體漏洞本身就是程式設計能力的延伸，能夠撰寫高品質程式碼的AI，同樣有能力分析程式碼、發現漏洞並進行修補。因此，AI在網路安全領域具有自然的應用潛力。
儘管科技業者在高盛大會上普遍釋放樂觀訊號，投資人卻沒有因此完全解除疑慮。高盛銷售與交易團隊指出，目前市場真正的核心爭論，在於AI資本支出究竟能否轉化為持久的獲利成長。
其中第一項關鍵問題，是大型雲端服務商能否將目前累積的大量訂單轉化為持續性的企業AI收入。隨著微軟、Alphabet、亞馬遜及Meta等大型科技公司持續投入數千億美元建設AI資料中心，市場需要看到這些基礎建設最終能產生足以支撐投資規模的實際收入。
第二項變化則出現在AI客戶的使用模式。高盛指出，企業客戶正逐漸從追求Token使用量最大化，轉向以投資報酬率為核心的「Token最佳化」。也就是說，企業不再單純追求使用更多AI，而是根據不同任務選擇適合的模型，在降低成本的同時提高AI使用效率。
這項變化可能成為AI產業下一階段的重要轉折。過去市場主要以模型能力、Token數量及運算需求衡量AI成長，但隨著企業進入實際商業部署階段，AI服務能否創造明確的經濟效益，將比單純增加使用量更為重要。
高盛科技大會釋放的整體訊號因此呈現「基本面看多、估值仍需驗證」的格局。一方面，晶片、記憶體、設備、資料中心、電力及網路安全等AI供應鏈仍處於強勁需求環境；另一方面，AI資本支出規模已經龐大到足以讓投資人開始要求更明確的營收及獲利回報。
目前市場的另一項重要觀察，是AI供應鏈瓶頸可能不會很快消失。從DRAM、先進封裝到資料中心、電力與潔淨室，AI運算需求的高速成長正同時推升多個產業的資本支出。高盛認為，部分供應限制可能一路延續至2028年，意味著AI基礎建設週期仍可能維持數年。
但對科技投資人而言，下一階段的焦點已經逐漸從「AI需求有多強」轉向「AI需求能產生多少回報」。只要大型雲端服務商能將積壓訂單轉化為穩定的企業AI收入，並證明AI投資可以帶來足夠高的報酬率，市場對AI資本支出的信心就有望延續；反之，如果AI使用量成長無法跟上基礎建設投資規模，市場對AI泡沫的疑慮仍可能重新升溫。
paras_en: Goldman Sachs' technology conference wrapped up on September 11 Pacific Time after four days, during which executives from Nvidia, SpaceX, Lam Research and several cybersecurity firms all signaled optimism about the AI industry, broadly agreeing that demand for AI infrastructure remains strong. However, Goldman’s sales and trading team noted that investors are still cautious, waiting for massive AI cap‑ex to translate into sustained revenue and profit growth.

The 2024 Goldman Sachs tech conference opened in San Francisco on September 8, with Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang, SpaceX CFO Bret Johnsen and other tech leaders taking the stage on September 10. On the final day, Goldman’s sales and trading team summed up that, compared with the first two days, the overall signal from participating companies remained “firmly bullish,” with healthy consumer demand, stable enterprise demand and chip supply still tight, yet investors remain hesitant to fully back AI infrastructure deals.

Jensen Huang’s remarks became the focal point of the event. He reiterated that global AI infrastructure spending is projected to reach $3‑$4 trillion annually by 2030, indicating that AI compute demand could continue its rapid growth for several years.

Huang said AI is not just another ordinary tech cycle but a fundamental shift from “retrieval‑based” to “generative” computing. He described AI data centers as “AI factories,” arguing that such infrastructure is gradually becoming a new class of asset for producing intelligence.

With Nvidia’s business expanding quickly, Huang noted that the AI industry’s bottleneck has moved beyond simple chip supply to the entire upstream‑downstream supply chain. Upstream challenges include advanced packaging, DRAM and LPDDR memory, connectors, voltage regulators and wafers; downstream challenges involve land, power and data‑center facilities.

Nevertheless, Huang believes Nvidia retains advantages across the supply chain. Upstream, the company runs one of the world’s largest supply networks; downstream, it has diversified sales channels capable of converting AI compute demand into larger‑scale product and service markets.

Goldman’s trading team also warned that constraints on power, memory, data‑center construction and capacity could keep AI compute supply short until 2028. In other words, even as AI server demand rises, the amount of compute the industry can actually deploy will remain limited by energy, land, facilities and semiconductor supply.

Beyond data centers, Huang is optimistic about AI extending into robotics. He expects a major inflection point for inference‑driven robot operation technology in about two years, meaning that as AI inference matures, robots could become the next major AI application market.

Addressing recent skepticism about “circular financing” in the AI sector, Huang countered that Nvidia’s investment size is relatively modest but can generate outsized returns, and the company can clearly see order demand from invested firms, so such investments should not be dismissed as mere circular financing.

SpaceX also expressed strong optimism about the AI infrastructure market. CFO Johnsen said the company is positioning itself as an integrated AI infrastructure platform, expecting each gigawatt of compute to generate $30‑$50 billion in revenue by 2027, and it is already near the top of that range.

Johnsen added that SpaceX is even more confident about achieving $100 billion of annualized revenue by year‑end. The firm projects total compute capacity to exceed 2 GW by the end of 2026 and reach 5‑10 GW by the end of 2027, while also planning to deploy AI satellites in 2027.

This plan indicates SpaceX is trying to combine space, satellite communications and AI compute resources into a model distinct from traditional large cloud providers. As AI models demand ever more compute and data‑transfer capacity, whether satellite and space‑based infrastructure can become the next‑generation compute resource is drawing increasing market attention.

Lam Research (LRCX‑US) executives also delivered a strong signal. CFO Doug Bettinger said the semiconductor equipment industry is currently “basically sold out,” and management is more concerned about missing upside opportunities than preparing for the next downturn.

Bettinger expects 2027 wafer‑fab equipment demand growth to be driven mainly by DRAM, but clean‑room capacity will remain a key constraint. As memory makers expand investment, new clean‑room capacity is slated to come online gradually before the end of 2027, with equipment supply likely remaining capacity‑limited until then.

The AI boom is also heating up the cybersecurity sector. Palo Alto Networks (PANW‑US) CEO Nikesh Arora said the AI security industry “has not even really been built yet,” suggesting that as AI agents, generative AI and enterprise AI applications proliferate, the related security market is still in its early stage.

CrowdStrike (CRWD‑US) CEO George Kurtz said AI is not displacing existing cybersecurity budgets; instead, it is driving higher security spending. He believes firms are shifting from purely defensive spend to investing in the foundational infrastructure needed to securely adopt AI.

Huang takes a more measured view of the cybersecurity hype. He noted that recent market focus on cybersecurity may partly reflect upcoming product launches, creating a degree of “manufacturing demand.” Nonetheless, he still sees cybersecurity as likely to become AI’s next major application arena.

Huang pointed out that finding software vulnerabilities is an extension of programming skill, and an AI capable of writing high‑quality code can also analyze code, discover flaws and patch them. Thus, AI has a natural application potential in cybersecurity.

Although tech companies at the Goldman conference generally sounded optimistic, investors remain unconvinced. Goldman’s sales and trading team said the core debate now centers on whether AI cap‑ex can translate into lasting profit growth.

The first key question is whether large cloud providers can turn the massive backlog of orders into sustained enterprise AI revenue. As Microsoft, Alphabet, Amazon and Meta pour tens of billions into AI data centers, the market needs to see those infrastructures generate real income sufficient to justify the investment scale.

The second shift concerns how AI customers use the technology. Goldman notes that enterprise clients are moving from maximizing token usage to “token optimization” focused on return on investment, meaning firms now select the most suitable models for each task, lowering costs while boosting AI efficiency.

This shift could be a pivotal turning point for the AI industry. Previously, growth was measured by model capability, token volume and compute demand, but as enterprises move into real‑world deployment, the ability of AI services to deliver clear economic benefits will matter more than sheer usage volume.

The overall signal from the Goldman tech conference therefore reflects a “bullish fundamentals, valuation still to be validated” outlook. On one hand, chips, memory, equipment, data centers, power and cybersecurity remain in a strong demand environment; on the other, AI cap‑ex has grown so large that investors now demand clearer revenue and profit returns.

Another market observation is that AI supply‑chain bottlenecks are unlikely to disappear quickly. From DRAM and advanced packaging to data centers, power and clean rooms, the rapid rise in AI compute demand is simultaneously driving capital spending across multiple industries. Goldman believes some supply constraints could persist through 2028, meaning the AI infrastructure cycle may last several years.

For tech investors, the focus is shifting from “how strong is AI demand” to “how much return can AI demand generate.” As long as large cloud providers can convert back‑log orders into stable enterprise AI revenue and prove AI investments yield sufficiently high returns, confidence in AI cap‑ex should endure; otherwise, if AI usage growth fails to keep pace with infrastructure spending, doubts about an AI bubble could re‑heat.

items.title: Fed年底前可能「升息3次」 美債殖利率逼近5% 市場壓力測試要來了
items.title_en: Fed May Raise Rates Three Times by Year‑End, U.S. Treasury Yields Near 5% – Market Stress Test Looms
paras: 《MarketWatch》報導，市場押注聯準會 (Fed) 下週重啟升息，但華爾街認為，升息行動可能不會只進行一次。部分分析師預估，Fed 年底前可能連續升息 3 次，屆時長天期美債殖利率若突破 5%，高額舉債支撐的人工智慧 (AI) 投資熱潮，以及保險業持有的私人信貸資產，恐將率先面臨壓力測試。
美國 8 月核心消費者物價指數 (CPI) 月增幅高於預期，市場對聯準會 (Fed) 下週升息 1 碼的押注升至約 86%，美國 2 年期公債殖利率上升約 8 個基點至 4.64%。10年期美國公債殖利率上升1個基點至4.97%。
BMO Capital Markets 美國利率策略主管 Ian Lyngen 預估，Fed 本月若升息 1 碼，10 月與 12 月可能再分別升息 1 碼。這將抵銷前主席鮑爾任內於 2025 年推動的降息，使聯邦基金利率目標區間回升至 4.25% 至 4.5%。
Vanguard 美國資深經濟學家 Josh Hirt 認為，以全年升息 3 次作為評估 Fed 政策路徑的起點「相當合理」，但實際結果仍可能落在升息 1 至 6 次之間。經濟學家指出，從歷史經驗來看，Fed 啟動升息後，通常不會僅調整一次。
若升息週期延續，AI 資本支出可能成為市場最明顯的脆弱環節之一。
Monetary Policy Analytics 政策經濟學家 Derek Tang 表示，投資人應特別關注推動 AI 支出週期的樂觀情緒，以及保險業持有的私人信貸資產。
Rockerfeller International 主席 Ruchir Sharma 日前也在《金融時報》撰文示警，美國政府預算赤字推升借貸需求，一旦公債殖利率升至 5%，大型科技公司將被迫與能提供高收益率的政府債券競爭資金，可能壓縮企業自債市籌措資金的空間，進而讓 AI 熱潮降溫。
Allianz Investment Management 資深投資組合經理 Charlie Ripley 同樣認為，10 年期美債殖利率若升至 5%，可能成為引發市場拋售的臨界點。他指出，參與 AI 競賽的超大規模雲端服務商未來數年的年度資本支出估計可能高達 1 兆美元，長天期殖利率攀升將直接推高這些企業的融資成本。
另一項風險則來自保險業與私人信貸市場。
國際貨幣基金 (IMF) 曾警告，由私募股權公司部分或完全持有的保險業者，營運與資產配置透明度不足，且投資較高風險的固定收益產品。一旦利率波動造成損失，衝擊可能進一步蔓延至銀行體系。
不過，Hirt 認為，這次潛在升息週期與過去引發重大金融危機的情況並不相同。
Fed 在 2022 至 2024 年間已進行大幅升息，目前利率仍處於相對高檔，市場也已提前調整預期，因此不至於像 2023 年矽谷銀行倒閉，或 1994 年加州橙縣破產時那樣，突然面臨政策方向逆轉。
Hirt 表示，Fed 此次更像是在尋找足以壓低通膨的適當利率水準，而非全面改變政策敘事。
歷史上仍有升息一次便停止的例外。Fed 在 1997 年僅升息一次，隨後維持利率不變，直到約 18 個月後才開始降息。
paras_en: MarketWatch reports that the market is betting the Fed will resume rate hikes next week, but Wall Street thinks the hikes may not be limited to a single move. Some analysts forecast up to three rate hikes by year‑end, which could push long‑term U.S. Treasury yields above 5%, putting pressure on the AI investment boom financed by heavy borrowing and on private‑credit assets held by insurers.

U.S. core CPI for August rose more than expected, lifting the market’s odds that the Fed will raise rates by a quarter point next week to about 86%. The 2‑year Treasury yield climbed roughly 8 basis points to 4.64%, while the 10‑year yield rose 1 basis point to 4.97%.

Ian Lyngen, head of U.S. rates strategy at BMO Capital Markets, projects that if the Fed hikes by a quarter point this month, it could raise rates again by a quarter point in both October and December. That would offset the rate cuts former Chair Powell plans for 2025, returning the federal‑funds target range to 4.25%‑4.5%.

Vanguard senior economist Josh Hirt says using three hikes over the year as a starting point for the Fed’s policy path is "quite reasonable," though the actual outcome could range from one to six hikes. He notes that historically the Fed rarely stops after a single increase once it begins tightening.
If the tightening cycle continues, AI capital spending could become one of the market’s most visible vulnerabilities.
Derek Tang, a policy economist at Monetary Policy Analytics, warns investors to watch the optimistic sentiment driving AI‑related spending cycles and the private‑credit assets held by insurers.

Ruchir Sharma, chairman of Rockefeller International, recently warned in the Financial Times that the U.S. budget deficit is boosting borrowing demand, and if Treasury yields hit 5% large tech firms will have to compete with high‑yield government bonds for funding, squeezing corporate access to bond markets and cooling the AI frenzy.

Charlie Ripley, senior portfolio manager at Allianz Investment Management, likewise believes a 5% 10‑year Treasury yield could trigger a market sell‑off. He points out that mega‑scale cloud providers competing in the AI race may spend up to $1 trillion annually over the next few years, and higher long‑term yields would directly raise their financing costs.
Another risk comes from the insurance sector and private‑credit markets.

The International Monetary Fund has warned that insurers owned partially or wholly by private‑equity firms often lack operational and asset‑allocation transparency and invest in higher‑risk fixed‑income products. Rate‑related losses could spill over into the banking system.
However, Hirt argues that this potential tightening cycle differs from past episodes that sparked major financial crises.

The Fed has already delivered large hikes from 2022 to 2024, leaving rates at relatively high levels. Markets have adjusted expectations in advance, so the situation is unlikely to resemble the sudden policy‑direction reversals seen after the 2023 Silicon Valley Bank collapse or the 1994 Orange County bankruptcy in California.
Hirt says the Fed this time is more about finding a rate level that can bring inflation down rather than overhauling its policy narrative.
Historically there are exceptions where the Fed stopped after a single hike. In 1997 the Fed raised rates only once and then held steady for about 18 months before beginning to cut.

items.title: 以黎羅馬下周談判突延至10月 南黎衝突持續升溫外交再添變數
items.title_en: Israel-Lebanon Talks Delayed to October as South Lebanon Conflict Escalates, Adding Diplomatic Uncertainty
paras: 以色列與黎巴嫩原定下周在義大利羅馬舉行的新一輪談判將延後至10月，Axios周五(11日)引述一名美國官員報導，由於猶太節日、巴黎一場國際會議以及聯合國大會相關籌備工作，與會人士無法在下周齊聚羅馬，因此談判行程被迫順延。與此同時，黎巴嫩與以色列駐美大使預計先在華盛頓會面，外交管道仍將維持運作。
這場談判原本被視為推動今年6月美國斡旋停火框架的重要一環。以色列與黎巴嫩自今年初爆發新一輪衝突後，在美國協調下已展開多輪直接談判，雙方核心爭議包括以色列從黎巴嫩南部撤軍、真主黨解除武裝，以及由黎巴嫩政府軍逐步接管南部安全區域等問題。8月初在羅馬舉行的第7輪談判，就是圍繞這些議題展開。
最新一輪談判原本預計於9月中旬在羅馬舉行。以色列公共廣播KAN本周稍早報導，以色列與黎巴嫩預計下周恢復談判，重點是推動雙方6月達成的框架協議；當時相關報導也指出，儘管以色列持續在黎巴嫩境內展開軍事行動，雙方仍計畫維持外交接觸。
如今談判延後至10月，顯示外交進程仍容易受到地區安全局勢及國際行程影響。不過，美國斡旋的外交管道並未中斷。根據Axios引述的美國官員說法，黎巴嫩及以色列駐美大使將在華盛頓會面，意味著雙方仍可能透過首都外交先行處理部分問題，再為10月羅馬會談鋪路。
以色列與黎巴嫩今年的談判，是兩國數十年來少見的直接外交接觸。7月在羅馬舉行的談判中，黎巴嫩希望取得以色列分階段撤出南部的明確進展，但當時外界對短期內達成突破的期待並不高。美國國務院當時表示，雙方談判氣氛正面，並願意繼續推進。
然而，談判桌上的外交進程與黎巴嫩南部的軍事現實仍存在明顯落差。以色列軍方近期持續在黎巴嫩南部展開空襲及拆除行動，並將目標鎖定真主黨的武器庫、地下設施及軍事基礎設施。9月10日，以色列宣布摧毀位於南黎巴嫩阿里塔赫爾山脊(Ali al-Taher ridge)的一處大型真主黨地下設施，並宣稱已取得該地區地上及地下的「作戰控制」。
以色列總理Benjamin Netanyahu及國防部長Israel Katz表示，這項行動完成了建立安全區的重要階段。以色列軍方稱，遭摧毀的地下網絡長約2公里，內部包括火箭、飛彈、無人機、反裝甲武器及爆炸物，並設有指揮中心、武器儲藏空間及可供人員長期停留的設施。該山脊距離以色列邊境約15公里。
阿里塔赫爾山脊正是以黎談判最敏感的地點之一。美國曾提出由真主黨將該戰略高地交由黎巴嫩軍隊控制，作為更廣泛解除真主黨武裝及拆除其軍事基礎設施計畫的一部分，但真主黨拒絕相關要求。黎巴嫩軍方則表示願意接管部分地區，但以色列與黎巴嫩對撤軍及安全安排仍存在重大歧見。
6月停火框架的基本方向，是以色列逐步撤出黎巴嫩南部，同時真主黨解除武裝並由黎巴嫩國家安全部隊接管相關區域。不過，真主黨拒絕在利塔尼河以北地區全面解除武裝，而以色列則堅持必須先確保真主黨軍事能力受到限制，才會進一步撤軍，使雙方始終難以就執行順序達成共識。
軍事衝突也持續對外交談判形成壓力。9月6日，以色列空襲黎巴嫩南部造成至少7人死亡，包括2名女性，黎巴嫩衛生部門另通報多人受傷。以色列表示行動是回應真主黨無人機攻擊，目標為真主黨武器設施；黎巴嫩總統Joseph Aoun則譴責以色列攻擊，並要求美國及國際社會介入。
隔日，黎巴嫩南部Kfar Rumman又遭以色列空襲，造成至少12人死亡，包括2名兒童，成為近期最嚴重的單日傷亡事件之一。以色列軍方表示，攻擊目標是轉移武器的人員，並稱已採取措施降低平民傷亡，但黎巴嫩方面指出，部分攻擊發生時並未發布撤離警告。
目前的停火因此更接近一種脆弱且不完整的停火狀態，而非真正結束敵對行動。美聯社報導，6月停火後黎巴嫩大部分地區的戰鬥有所減少，但阿里塔赫爾山脊等戰略區域仍頻繁遭到以色列空襲及炮擊，真主黨則以無人機等方式反擊。
黎巴嫩境內的人道情勢同樣令人擔憂。近期南部村鎮仍出現房屋及公共設施遭摧毀的情況，部分居民在停火後返回家園，但由於軍事行動持續，仍有超過30萬人處於流離失所狀態。美聯社指出，今年3月以來的衝突高峰期間，流離失所人數曾超過120萬人。
外交延後之際，中東其他戰線也正在增加以黎談判的複雜度。美國與以色列對伊朗的軍事衝突持續牽動真主黨及黎巴嫩局勢，伊朗支持的武裝組織活動也使區域安全環境更加不穩定。尤其紅海及荷姆茲海峽的航運安全近期同樣受到威脅，讓美國政府必須同時處理多條中東安全戰線。
此外，聯合國大會即將召開，也使華盛頓、巴黎及紐約近期的外交行程高度密集。原定羅馬談判因猶太節日、巴黎會議及聯大籌備工作而順延，顯示即使雙方仍希望維持談判，實際安排也受到更廣泛國際外交議程牽制。
因此，10月羅馬會談能否真正恢復，將成為觀察以黎停火框架是否還有機會推進的重要指標。若雙方能先透過華盛頓的外交接觸縮小分歧，10月談判可能重新聚焦以色列撤軍時間表、黎巴嫩軍隊部署及真主黨武裝問題；但若南黎軍事衝突持續升高，外交進程恐怕仍將面臨重大阻力。
paras_en: Israel and Lebanon’s planned new round of talks in Rome next week has been pushed back to October, Axios reported on Friday (the 11th) quoting a U.S. official. The postponement is due to the Jewish holiday, an international conference in Paris and United Nations General Assembly preparations, which prevent participants from gathering in Rome next week. Meanwhile, the Lebanese and Israeli ambassadors to the United States are expected to meet in Washington, keeping diplomatic channels open.

The talks were originally seen as a key element in advancing the U.S.-brokered cease‑fire framework reached in June. Since the fresh round of fighting broke out earlier this year, Israel and Lebanon have held several direct rounds of negotiations under U.S. coordination. Core issues include Israeli withdrawal from southern Lebanon, Hezbollah disarmament and a phased hand‑over of the security zone to the Lebanese army. The seventh round in early August in Rome focused on those topics.

The latest round was slated for mid‑September in Rome. Earlier this week Israel’s public broadcaster KAN reported that Israel and Lebanon expected to resume talks next week, aiming to implement the framework agreed in June. The report noted that despite Israel’s ongoing military operations inside Lebanon, both sides still planned to maintain diplomatic contact.

The shift of the talks to October shows how the diplomatic process remains vulnerable to regional security conditions and international itineraries. Nevertheless, the U.S.‑mediated diplomatic track has not been broken. According to the Axios‑cited U.S. official, the Lebanese and Israeli ambassadors in Washington will meet, meaning the parties may first address some issues in the U.S. capital before the October Rome session.

Negotiations between Israel and Lebanon this year are a rare instance of direct diplomatic engagement after decades. In the July talks in Rome, Lebanon sought clear, phased Israeli withdrawal from the south, but expectations for a short‑term breakthrough were modest. The U.S. State Department at the time said the atmosphere was constructive and that they would keep pushing forward.

However, the diplomatic progress at the table still starkly contrasts with the military reality in southern Lebanon. The Israeli military has recently intensified air strikes and demolition operations there, targeting Hezbollah weapon caches, underground facilities and infrastructure. On September 10, Israel announced it had destroyed a large Hezbollah underground complex on the Ali al‑Taher ridge in southern Lebanon and claimed to have seized “operational control” of the area above and below ground.

Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu and Defense Minister Israel Katz said the operation marked an important step in establishing a security zone. The Israeli military described the destroyed underground network as about two kilometres long, housing rockets, missiles, drones, anti‑armor weapons and explosives, as well as a command centre, weapons storage and facilities for long‑term personnel stay. The ridge lies roughly 15 km from the Israeli border.

The Ali al‑Taher ridge is one of the most sensitive points in the Israel‑Lebanon talks. The United States has proposed that Hezbollah hand the strategic high ground over to the Lebanese army as part of a broader plan to disarm Hezbollah and dismantle its military infrastructure, but Hezbollah has rejected the proposal. The Lebanese army says it is willing to take over parts of the area, yet Israel and Lebanon still disagree sharply on withdrawal and security arrangements.

The basic direction of the June cease‑fire framework calls for a phased Israeli pull‑out from southern Lebanon, Hezbollah disarmament and hand‑over of the zone to Lebanese national security forces. Hezbollah, however, refuses a full disarmament north of the Litani River, while Israel insists that Hezbollah’s capabilities must be limited first before any further Israeli withdrawal, leaving the parties unable to agree on the sequence of implementation.

Military clashes continue to pressure the diplomatic process. On September 6, an Israeli air strike in southern Lebanon killed at least seven people, including two women, and the Lebanese health ministry reported multiple injuries. Israel said the strike was a response to a Hezbollah drone attack and targeted weapons facilities; Lebanese President Joseph Aoun condemned the attack and called for U.S. and international intervention.

The next day, Israel bombed Kfar Rumman in southern Lebanon, killing at least twelve people, including two children, making it one of the deadliest single‑day incidents recently. The Israeli military said the target was personnel moving weapons and claimed steps were taken to minimise civilian casualties, while Lebanese officials said no evacuation warning was issued before parts of the attack.

The current cease‑fire therefore resembles a fragile, incomplete pause rather than a true end to hostilities. The Associated Press reported that fighting has lessened in most of Lebanon since the June cease‑fire, but strategic areas such as the Ali al‑Taher ridge continue to face frequent Israeli air strikes and artillery fire, with Hezbollah responding with drones and other means.

Humanitarian conditions inside Lebanon remain alarming. Recent reports note that homes and public facilities in southern villages are still being destroyed; some residents have returned since the cease‑fire, but ongoing military actions leave more than 300,000 people displaced. The AP noted that at the peak of the conflict since March, displacement exceeded 1.2 million.

The diplomatic delay comes as other Middle‑East fronts add complexity to the Israel‑Lebanon talks. The U.S. and Israel’s ongoing military confrontation with Iran continues to influence Hezbollah and Lebanon, and Iran‑backed militias further destabilise the regional security environment. Recent threats to shipping in the Red Sea and the Hormuz Strait also demand U.S. attention across multiple Middle‑East security lines.

In addition, the upcoming United Nations General Assembly makes diplomatic schedules in Washington, Paris and New York especially dense. The Rome talks were postponed because of the Jewish holiday, the Paris conference and UNGA preparations, showing that even if both sides wish to keep negotiations alive, the actual timing is constrained by a broader international diplomatic agenda.

Thus, whether the October meeting in Rome can truly resume will be a key barometer of the cease‑fire framework’s prospects. If the parties can narrow their gaps through Washington‑based diplomatic contacts, the October talks may refocus on Israel’s withdrawal timetable, Lebanese troop deployment and Hezbollah disarmament; but if fighting in southern Lebanon continues to intensify, the diplomatic process is likely to face major obstacles.

items.title: Salesforce乘AI樂觀情緒上漲 華爾街下一步關注什麼？
items.title_en: Salesforce rides AI optimism surge; what’s the next focus on Wall Street?
paras: 《MarketWatch》周五(11日)報導，投資人開始看好Salesforce(CRM-US)有望成為更具實力的AI業者，但這項新敘事將在下周公司於舊金山舉行年度Dreamforce大會時接受考驗。
Salesforce股價在8月公布財報後隔日大漲23%，這不僅是市場對財報數字的肯定，也代表投資人對公司AI策略投下信任票。不過，分析師認為，這股動能能否延續，目前仍存在爭議。
Salesforce股價周五上漲近2%。
瑞銀分析師Karl Keirstead在報告中指出，Dreamforce大會上，投資人將關注近期宣布的Claudeforce，這項合作將Anthropic的Claude直接整合進Salesforce平台。
Keirstead解釋，這項合作結合了「Anthropic先進模型的推理能力，以及Salesforce內建的客戶資料、工作流程、商業邏輯與治理機制」。
他指出，此次宣布的核心內容，是推出一款新的外掛程式，讓該AI先進實驗室的使用者可以直接透過自身平台存取並操作Salesforce資料，而不必透過Salesforce傳統的使用者介面(UI)。
Keirstead表示，儘管他對這項合作持正面看法，但現在判斷其對Salesforce 2028會計年度營收成長的影響仍言之過早。該會計年度將於當年1月結束。
Needham分析師Scott Berg表示，Claudeforce確實代表「策略轉變」，但他仍對客戶可能如何看待採用Claude配置的Salesforce平台抱持疑問。
重要的是，將Claude整合進Salesforce平台，在某些方面意味著Salesforce將讓出對使用者介面層的控制權。例如，公司必須放棄決定使用者從何處存取Salesforce資料的部分控制權。
Berg問道，「Salesforce讓使用Claude的客戶放棄原有的UI，以存取Salesforce資料，是否會負面改變客戶對Salesforce平台的看法？」
這是投資人擔心的問題，因為如果Salesforce平台的價值受到負面影響，可能進而影響客戶為Salesforce的資料及工作流程付費的意願。另一種情況則是，這項合作可能促使客戶解鎖Salesforce資料的新功能及價值。Berg認為目前「還言之過早」。
Dreamforce大會將於9月15日開幕。
paras_en: MarketWatch reported on Friday the 11th that investors are beginning to view Salesforce (CRM‑US) as potentially becoming a stronger AI player, but this new narrative will be tested next week when the company holds its annual Dreamforce conference in San Francisco.

Salesforce’s stock jumped 23% the day after it released its August earnings, reflecting not only market approval of the numbers but also investors’ confidence in the company’s AI strategy. However, analysts say there is still debate over whether this momentum can be sustained.
Salesforce’s share price rose nearly 2% on Friday.

UBS analyst Karl Keirstead noted in his report that at Dreamforce investors will focus on the recently announced Claudeforce, a partnership that integrates Anthropic’s Claude directly into the Salesforce platform.
Keirstead explained that the collaboration combines “Anthropic’s advanced model reasoning capabilities with Salesforce’s built‑in customer data, workflows, business logic, and governance mechanisms.”

He pointed out that the core of the announcement is a new plug‑in that allows users of the AI lab to access and operate Salesforce data directly through their own platform, without going through Salesforce’s traditional user interface (UI).

Keirstead said that although he views the partnership positively, it is still too early to judge its impact on Salesforce’s fiscal‑year‑2028 revenue growth. That fiscal year ends in January of that year.
Needham analyst Scott Berg said Claudeforce does represent a “strategic shift,” but he remains uncertain how customers will perceive a Salesforce platform configured with Claude.

Importantly, integrating Claude into the Salesforce platform means that, in some respects, Salesforce will cede control of the UI layer. For example, the company must give up some control over where users access Salesforce data.
Berg asked, “Will Salesforce’s decision to let customers using Claude abandon the existing UI to access Salesforce data negatively change customers’ view of the Salesforce platform?”

This is the investors’ concern, because if the platform’s value is perceived negatively it could reduce customers’ willingness to pay for Salesforce data and workflows. Conversely, the partnership could unlock new functions and value from Salesforce data. Berg believes it is still “too early to say.”
The Dreamforce conference will open on September 15.

Fed升息幾乎成定局反而大漲？美股接下來才是真正考驗

美國8月通膨數據幾乎確立聯準會(Fed)下周升息1碼的預期，為9月初連續下挫的美股提供些許確定性。然而，升息答案塵埃落定，不代表市場已擺脫困境，高油價、美債殖利率、消費力下滑及企業獲利能否延續成長，仍是年底前的主要考驗。全文詳讀

AI需求旺！戴爾大漲12%獲RBC看好 今年飆升近350% 

戴爾科技(Dell Technologies)(DELL-US)股價周五(11日)大漲12%，此前RBC Capital Markets啟動對該電腦製造商的分析，並給予優於大盤的股票評級及640美元的目標價。戴爾周五上漲之際，今年迄今股價已飆升超過4倍。這家老牌PC製造商已成為輝達(Nvidia)(NVDA-US)平台伺服器及相關設備的主要供應商之一。全文詳讀

美國8月核心消費者物價指數(CPI)升幅高於預期，讓聯準會(Fed)主席華許(Kevin Warsh)在下周政策會議支持升息的壓力陡增。市場認為，這份數據不僅削弱通膨即將自行降溫的論點，也讓華許難以在發表強硬抗通膨演說後繼續按兵不動。全文詳讀

美債5%魔王關要破了？油價狂飆引爆全球債市風暴

全球債市周五(11日)延續猛烈賣壓，美國10年期公債殖利率逼近備受關注的5%關卡。油價突破每桶100美元、通膨疑慮升溫，加上聯準會(Fed)最快下周升息的可能性提高，促使投資人重新評估全球利率走勢。全文詳讀

手機資費竟成最後一根稻草！美國核心通膨超預期 Fed下周恐升息

美國一波手機資費調漲，意外成為推升8月核心通膨的重要因素，甚至可能成為促使聯準會(Fed)下周升息的最後一根稻草。美國勞工統計局公布，排除食品與能源的核心消費者物價指數(CPI)8月月增0.3%，高於《彭博》調查預估的0.2%。其中，無線電話服務價格單月大漲5.9%，創有紀錄以來最大增幅。全文詳讀
paras_en: The August inflation data in the United States has almost cemented expectations that the Federal Reserve will raise rates by one quarter point next week, giving a bit of certainty to the market after the early‑September decline in US stocks. However, the rate‑hike question being settled does not mean the market has escaped trouble; high oil prices, US Treasury yields, weakening consumer spending and whether corporate earnings can keep growing remain the main challenges before year‑end.

Dell Technologies (DELL‑US) surged 12% on Friday the 11th after RBC Capital Markets initiated coverage of the computer maker, assigning it an above‑average rating and a target price of $640. Dell’s stock has already jumped more than four‑fold this year, and the veteran PC manufacturer has become one of the main suppliers of Nvidia’s (NVDA‑US) platform servers and related equipment.

The core US Consumer Price Index (CPI) for August rose more than expected, sharply increasing pressure on Fed Chair Kevin Warsh to support a rate hike at next week’s policy meeting. Markets see the data as undermining the argument that inflation will cool on its own and making it difficult for Warsh to stay on the sidelines after delivering a tough anti‑inflation speech.

Global bond markets continued to face heavy selling on Friday the 11th, pushing the yield on the US 10‑year Treasury close to the closely watched 5% threshold. Oil prices breaking $100 a barrel, renewed inflation concerns and the heightened likelihood of a Fed rate hike as early as next week have led investors to reassess the trajectory of global interest rates.

A wave of mobile‑phone price hikes in the United States unexpectedly became a key driver of the August core CPI increase and could be the final straw that pushes the Fed to raise rates next week. The Bureau of Labor Statistics reported that the core CPI, which excludes food and energy, rose 0.3% month‑over‑month in August, above Bloomberg’s forecast of 0.2%. Wireless telephone service prices jumped 5.9% in a single month, the largest increase on record.

items.title: 葉門政府軍猛轟摩卡「殺戮區」 阻胡塞武裝逼近曼德海峽
items.title_en: Yemen Government Forces Bombard 'Killing Zone' in Mocha to Halt Houthi Advance Toward the Bab al-Mandab Strait
paras: 伊朗支持的胡塞武裝近日快速向葉門西南部推進，奪取重要港口城市摩卡，並宣稱已控制葉門整段紅海沿岸及曼德海峽周邊地區。獲沙烏地阿拉伯支持的葉門政府軍週五 (11 日) 表示，已對摩卡至曼德海峽之間的「殺戮區」展開猛烈空襲與轟炸，試圖遏止胡塞武裝繼續向南擴張。
《半島電視台》報導，葉門政府軍已撤出摩卡及其南方地區，包括佐巴卜市。胡塞武裝隨後占領當地空軍基地，並進一步向連接紅海與亞丁灣的曼德海峽推進。
胡塞武裝軍事發言人Yahya Saree 宣稱，該組織已將沙烏地支持的部隊逐出 6 個地區，全面掌握葉門紅海沿岸。他並表示，除沙烏地阿拉伯船隻外，其他航運公司的船舶仍可安全通行。
胡塞武裝近日也在社群平台發布照片及影片，聲稱已控制曼德海峽周邊，甚至進一步向南推進。當地記者指出，胡塞武裝仍有意擴張勢力，但目前尚未出現願意或有能力在地面阻止其推進的力量。
葉門政府軍發言人則表示，已開始對摩卡附近的「殺戮區」失守地帶展開猛烈空襲與轟炸。
這些失守地帶，範圍涵蓋摩卡至曼德海峽一帶，自 2017 年以來一直是政府軍抵擋胡塞武裝的重要防線，如今接連失守，可能大幅改變葉門內戰版圖。
胡塞掌握戰略咽喉 紅海航運風險升高
曼德海峽是連接紅海與亞丁灣的戰略水道，也是船舶往返蘇伊士運河、亞洲及歐洲的必經航線。胡塞武裝若能鞏固周邊控制權，即使不直接封鎖海峽，也可能憑藉岸基飛彈、無人機及小型船艇對航運施加更大壓力。
葉門南方過渡委員會外交事務代表Amr al-Bidh 表示，他先前已向西方外交官警告，國際社會需要制定全面性的國內、區域及國際策略因應胡塞武裝，零星空襲不足以阻止其擴張。
al-Bidh 指出，胡塞武裝進駐曼德海峽周邊後，即使不動用先進武器，也能直接影響航道安全，並可將飛彈等武器調往其他戰線。
聯合國也證實，胡塞武裝已接管摩卡一處人道援助設施。聯合國秘書長副發言人Farhan Haq 表示，相關工作人員已事先撤離，現場沒有聯合國雇員，所有人員均安全。他呼籲交戰各方保護人道工作人員、場所及資產。
沙烏地船隻遭點名 能源出口替代路線同步受阻
就在胡塞武裝宣布沙烏地船隻不再享有安全通行保證之際，沙烏地阿拉伯東西向輸油管線也因多次遇襲而預防性停運。這條管線將沙國東部產油區的原油輸送至紅海港口延布，是沙烏地避開荷姆茲海峽的主要出口替代路線。
沙烏地外交部表示，攻擊管線的無人機來自伊拉克境內。利雅德現階段決定暫不反擊，以便讓伊拉克政府採取措施，防止境內再被利用對沙烏地及鄰國發動攻擊。
伊拉克政府隨後確認，無人機從南部米桑省發射，已撤換當地軍事指揮官，並成立調查委員會追查幕後涉事者。
目前沒有證據顯示，這起輸油管線攻擊由胡塞武裝策動，因此兩起事件不能直接畫上等號。
不過，胡塞武裝控制葉門紅海沿岸，加上沙烏地避開荷姆茲海峽的主要輸油路線停擺，使紅海與荷姆茲海峽兩條能源運輸命脈同時承受壓力。
專家示警運輸風險恐轉化為通膨壓力
大西洋理事會全球能源中心資深研究員Ben Cahill 表示，東西向輸油管線是沙烏地避開荷姆茲海峽的主要替代選項，若長時間停運，將嚴重影響原油出口，進一步推升已經吃緊的全球能源市場壓力。
經濟學家Javed Hassan 指出，胡塞武裝推進造成的衝擊，不能只用實際減少多少原油供應衡量。更大的問題是替代航線、備用產能及物流調度空間遭到壓縮，使能源市場失去吸收突發事件的能力。
一旦市場認為紅海出口路線受到長期威脅，戰爭風險保費及船舶租金可能在貨物實際中斷前率先上漲，相關壓力也將由原油擴散至貨櫃航運、散裝運輸及其他商品，最終轉化為更廣泛的通膨衝擊。
外傳阿曼正推動海灣國家與伊朗高層週一在阿曼城市塞拉萊舉行會議，討論恢復荷姆茲海峽商業航運的協議，西德州原油期貨週五 (11日) 下跌 2.4%，收每桶 100.05 美元；布蘭特原油期貨下跌 2.8%，收每桶 104.61 美元。
儘管週五下跌，西德州原油本週仍累計大漲近 10%，布蘭特原油上漲近 9%。兩大指標油價本週均突破每桶 100 美元，兩週累計漲幅超過 18%。
paras_en: Iran-backed Houthi forces have recently surged southwestward in Yemen, seizing the key port city of Mocha and claiming control over Yemen's entire Red Sea coastline and the surrounding Bab al-Mandab area. The Saudi-backed Yemeni government forces said on Friday (the 11th) that they have launched heavy air strikes and bombings on the "killing zone" between Mocha and the Bab al-Mandab Strait in an effort to stop the Houthis from further southward expansion.

Al Jazeera reported that Yemeni government troops have withdrawn from Mocha and its southern environs, including the city of Zabab. Houthi fighters subsequently occupied the local air base and pushed further toward the Bab al-Mandab Strait that links the Red Sea with the Gulf of Aden.

Houthi military spokesman Yahya Saree claimed the group has expelled Saudi-backed forces from six districts and now fully controls Yemen's Red Sea coast. He added that, aside from Saudi Arabian vessels, ships from other shipping companies can still navigate safely.

The Houthis have also posted photos and videos on social media asserting they control the Bab al-Mandab area and are moving further south. Local journalists note the group still seeks to expand its influence, but no force currently appears willing or able to halt its ground advance.
A government spokesperson said heavy air strikes and bombings have begun against the lost “killing zone” near Mocha.

These lost zones, stretching from Mocha to the Bab al-Mandab, have served since 2017 as a crucial defensive line for government forces against the Houthis. Their recent collapse could dramatically reshape Yemen's civil‑war map.
Houthi Control of Strategic Choke Point Raises Red Sea Shipping Risks

The Bab al-Mandab Strait, a strategic waterway linking the Red Sea with the Gulf of Aden, is a vital corridor for vessels traveling between the Suez Canal, Asia and Europe. If the Houthis consolidate control around the strait, even without a full blockade, they could use shore‑based missiles, drones and small boats to increase pressure on shipping.

Amr al‑Bidh, the diplomatic affairs representative of Yemen’s Southern Transitional Council, said he had previously warned Western diplomats that the international community needs a comprehensive domestic, regional and global strategy to counter the Houthis, as sporadic air strikes are insufficient to stop their expansion.

Al‑Bidh noted that once the Houthis are present around the Bab al-Mandab, even without advanced weaponry they can directly affect the safety of the waterway and can redeploy missiles and other arms to other fronts.

The United Nations confirmed that the Houthis have taken over a humanitarian aid facility in Mocha. UN Secretary‑General deputy spokesperson Farhan Haq said staff had been evacuated in advance, no UN employees remain on site and all personnel are safe. He urged all parties to protect humanitarian workers, sites and assets.
Saudi‑Flagged Vessels Targeted as Alternative Energy Export Routes Also Disrupted

Just as the Houthis announced that Saudi ships would no longer enjoy safe‑passage guarantees, Saudi Arabia’s east‑west oil pipeline was put on preventive shutdown after multiple attacks. The pipeline carries crude from the kingdom’s eastern production fields to the Red Sea port of Yanbu, serving as Saudi Arabia’s main alternative export route that bypasses the Hormuz Strait.

Saudi Arabia’s foreign ministry said the drones that struck the pipeline originated from within Iraq. Riyadh has decided not to retaliate at this stage, allowing the Iraqi government to take measures to prevent its territory from being used for attacks on Saudi Arabia and neighboring states.

The Iraqi government later confirmed the drones were launched from the southern province of Maysan, has replaced the local military commander and set up an investigative committee to trace those responsible.
There is currently no evidence that the pipeline attack was orchestrated by the Houthis, so the two incidents should not be directly equated.

Nevertheless, Houthi control of Yemen’s Red Sea coast, combined with the shutdown of Saudi Arabia’s main alternative oil route that avoids the Hormuz Strait, puts simultaneous pressure on both the Red Sea and the Hormuz Strait as vital energy corridors.
Experts Warn Transport Risks Could Translate Into Inflationary Pressure

Ben Cahill, a senior researcher at the Atlantic Council’s Global Energy Center, said the east‑west pipeline is Saudi Arabia’s primary alternative to bypass Hormuz, and a prolonged shutdown would severely curb crude exports, further tightening an already strained global energy market.

Economist Javed Hassan pointed out that the impact of the Houthi advance cannot be measured solely by the volume of crude lost. A bigger issue is the compression of alternative routes, spare capacity and logistics flexibility, which erodes the market’s ability to absorb shocks.

If markets perceive a long‑term threat to Red Sea export routes, war‑risk premiums and vessel charter rates may rise before any actual cargo disruption occurs, spreading pressure from crude oil to container shipping, bulk transport and other commodities, ultimately feeding broader inflation.

Reports suggest Oman is facilitating a meeting on Monday in the Omani city of Salalah between Gulf states and senior Iranian officials to discuss restoring commercial navigation through the Hormuz Strait. West Texas Intermediate crude fell 2.4% on Friday (the 11th) to $100.05 a barrel, while Brent fell 2.8% to $104.61 a barrel.

Despite Friday’s decline, West Texas Intermediate has risen nearly 10% this week and Brent almost 9%. Both benchmark crude prices have broken the $100‑a‑barrel mark this week, with a two‑week gain of over 18%.

items.title: 傳輝達擬砸100億美元押注Anthropic！AI史上最大IPO估值上看2兆美元
items.title_en: Nvidia Mulls $10 B Bet on Anthropic! AI’s Largest IPO Valuation Could Reach $2 T
paras: 人工智慧新創Anthropic正與輝達(NVDA-US)洽談，考慮讓這家全球最具影響力的AI晶片製造商成為其超大型首次公開募股(IPO)的基石投資人。知情人士透露，Anthropic計畫在IPO中募資最高達1,000億美元，目標估值約2兆美元，而輝達考慮投入的資金最高可能達100億美元。相關討論仍在進行，最終條件、金額及時間表都可能改變。
若交易成行，輝達將成為Anthropic此次IPO的重要早期戰略投資人，不僅能替這場可能創下歷史紀錄的超大型上市案提供市場信心，也將進一步深化雙方已相當緊密的商業關係。Reuters指出，這場IPO將成為公開市場對前沿AI企業超高估值及龐大資本需求承受能力的一項重大測試。
所謂基石投資人，通常是指在IPO正式向更廣泛市場推介前，就承諾認購一定比例股票的機構投資人，藉此向其他投資人釋放對公司及發行價格的信心。隨著大型科技企業及AI新創的募資規模快速擴大，超大型IPO提前尋找基石投資人的做法也愈來愈普遍。先前晶片設計商Arm的基石投資人就包括輝達與亞馬遜，而SpaceX的基石投資人則包括沙烏地阿拉伯公共投資基金(PIF)。
Anthropic目前高度依賴輝達GPU提供AI模型訓練與推論所需的算力，但隨著Claude需求快速增加，公司也積極降低對單一晶片供應商的依賴。Anthropic已分別與亞馬遜及Google合作取得自研AI晶片算力，同時還開始組建內部硬體團隊，希望自行設計針對Claude最佳化的客製化晶片，以進一步控制硬體成本。
雙方的合作關係早已不僅限於晶片供應。2025年11月，輝達宣布將對Anthropic投資最高100億美元，並與Anthropic建立更廣泛的合作關係。在相關安排下，Anthropic承諾採購300億美元、由輝達晶片驅動的Microsoft Azure運算容量，顯示輝達正透過投資、晶片供應及雲端基礎設施形成更深的AI生態系合作。

Anthropic目前的主要投資人還包括亞馬遜(AMZN-US)與Google母公司Alphabet(GOOGL-US)，而這兩家公司同時也是Anthropic的重要算力供應商。4月，Anthropic宣布與亞馬遜擴大合作，未來10年將向Amazon Web Services(AWS)投入超過1,000億美元，並取得最高5GW的新運算容量，其中包括超過100萬顆Trainium2晶片，以及截至2026年底陸續上線的Trainium2與Trainium3算力。
Anthropic同時也與Google及Broadcom(AVGO-US)擴大合作，取得多GW的新一代TPU運算容量，預計自2027年開始陸續上線，用於支援Claude模型及全球客戶快速增加的需求。Anthropic表示，這是公司迄今最重大的算力擴充計畫之一。
Anthropic對算力的需求正在隨營收高速成長。公司2025年底的年化營收約90億美元，到2026年5月已突破470億美元，7月底更進一步超過650億美元。Reuters此前報導，這項年化營收數字是根據當前銷售速度推估全年表現，反映Claude商業化速度大幅加快。
Anthropic在今年5月完成650億美元H輪融資，投資人包括Altimeter Capital、Dragoneer、Greenoaks及Sequoia Capital，投後估值達9,650億美元。換言之，若此次IPO最終以約2兆美元估值完成，Anthropic的市場估值將在數個月內再度大幅翻升。
公司對未來營收的預期同樣極為激進。Reuters先前報導，Anthropic預估2028年營收可能達1,900億至2,000億美元，這項預測將是支撐其2兆美元潛在估值的重要依據之一。
若IPO依照目前規畫推進，預計將在11月美國期中選舉前完成。這意味著Anthropic可能成為今年全球資本市場最受矚目的上市案之一，也將與OpenAI等其他大型AI企業的潛在IPO形成直接比較。
AI新創的資本需求正在快速膨脹。OpenAI今年2月宣布規模達1,100億美元的融資，估值達8,400億美元，其中包括輝達300億美元、軟銀300億美元及亞馬遜500億美元的投資，顯示大型科技公司及資本市場正競相透過股權投資與算力合作卡位下一階段AI產業。
與此同時，Anthropic及OpenAI等前沿AI企業也正尋求在IPO後取得投資級信用評等，以降低未來發債及融資成本。金融機構預期，若這些企業能取得投資級評等，將有機會進一步進入規模達11.7兆美元的企業債市場，為資料中心、晶片採購及AI基礎建設提供額外資金來源。
Anthropic的IPO因此不只是單純的科技公司上市案，更牽動輝達、Google、亞馬遜、Broadcom及大型金融機構所建立的AI算力供應鏈。隨著前沿AI模型對GPU、TPU、資料中心、電力及雲端運算容量的需求同步攀升，Anthropic若以接近2兆美元估值上市，將成為資本市場衡量AI產業高估值能否由快速成長營收支撐的重要指標。
paras_en: AI startup Anthropic is in talks with Nvidia (NVDA-US) about making the world’s most influential AI chip maker a cornerstone investor in its mega‑initial public offering. Sources say Anthropic plans to raise up to $100 billion in the IPO, targeting a valuation of about $2 trillion, and Nvidia could commit as much as $10 billion. Discussions are ongoing and final terms, amounts and timing could change.

If the deal goes through, Nvidia would become a key early strategic investor in Anthropic’s IPO, bolstering market confidence in what could be a record‑breaking mega‑listing and deepening an already close commercial relationship. Reuters notes the IPO will be a major test of the public market’s appetite for frontier‑AI firms with sky‑high valuations and massive capital needs.

A cornerstone investor is an institution that commits to buying a set share of stock before the IPO is marketed to the broader market, signalling confidence in the company and its pricing. As fundraising scales for big‑tech and AI startups, seeking cornerstones ahead of ultra‑large IPOs is becoming routine. Earlier, chip designer Arm counted Nvidia and Amazon among its cornerstones, while SpaceX’s cornerstones include Saudi Arabia’s Public Investment Fund (PIF).

Anthropic currently relies heavily on Nvidia GPUs for the compute power needed to train and run its Claude models, but as demand for Claude surges the company is actively reducing dependence on a single chip supplier. Anthropic has partnered with Amazon and Google to secure custom AI‑chip capacity and is building an internal hardware team to design a Claude‑optimized chip, aiming to better control hardware costs.

The partnership goes beyond chip supply. In November 2025 Nvidia announced a potential $10 billion investment in Anthropic and a broader collaboration. Under the deal, Anthropic pledged to purchase $30 billion of Microsoft Azure compute powered by Nvidia chips, showing Nvidia is weaving deeper AI‑ecosystem ties through investment, chip supply and cloud infrastructure.

Anthropic’s other major investors include Amazon (AMZN-US) and Google parent Alphabet (GOOGL-US), both also key compute providers. In April Anthropic said it would expand its tie‑up with Amazon, committing over $100 billion to AWS over the next decade and securing up to 5 GW of new compute capacity, including more than 1 million Trainium 2 chips and additional Trainium 2 and Trainium 3 capacity slated to come online through the end of 2026.

Anthropic is also expanding cooperation with Google and Broadcom (AVGO-US) to obtain several gigawatts of next‑generation TPU capacity, expected to roll out from 2027 to support Claude and rapidly growing global demand. The company calls this its biggest compute‑expansion plan to date.

Anthropic’s compute needs are rising with its fast‑growing revenue. Annualized revenue was about $9 billion at the end of 2025, topped $47 billion by May 2026, and exceeded $65 billion by late July. Reuters previously reported that these annualized figures are extrapolated from current sales velocity, reflecting a sharp acceleration in Claude’s commercialization.

In May this year Anthropic closed a $65 billion Series H round, backed by Altimeter Capital, Dragoneer, Greenoaks and Sequoia Capital, valuing the company at $965 billion post‑money. In other words, if the IPO ultimately lands at roughly a $2 trillion valuation, Anthropic’s market cap would surge dramatically again within months.

The firm’s revenue outlook is equally aggressive. Reuters earlier reported Anthropic projects 2028 revenue of $190 billion to $200 billion, a forecast that underpins the potential $2 trillion valuation.

If the IPO proceeds as planned, it is expected to close before the U.S. mid‑term elections in November, making Anthropic one of the most watched listings of the year and a direct comparator to potential IPOs from other AI giants such as OpenAI.

AI startups’ capital needs are ballooning. OpenAI announced a $110 billion financing round in February, valuing it at $840 billion, with Nvidia, SoftBank and Amazon each contributing $30 billion, $30 billion and $50 billion respectively, illustrating how big‑tech firms and capital markets are racing to secure equity stakes and compute partnerships for the next AI wave.

At the same time, Anthropic, OpenAI and other frontier AI firms are seeking investment‑grade credit ratings after their IPOs to lower future borrowing and financing costs. Analysts say that if these firms achieve such ratings, they could tap the $11.7 trillion corporate bond market, providing extra funding for data centers, chip purchases and AI infrastructure.

Anthropic’s IPO is therefore more than a tech‑company listing; it pulls in Nvidia, Google, Amazon, Broadcom and major financial institutions that form the AI compute supply chain. As cutting‑edge AI models drive up demand for GPUs, TPUs, data‑center power and cloud capacity, a near‑$2 trillion‑valued listing would become a key barometer for whether the market’s lofty AI valuations can be sustained by rapid revenue growth.

items.title: 〈紐約匯市〉美元上漲 Fed下周升息可能性提高
items.title_en: New York FX Market: Dollar Rises as Fed Rate‑Hike Likelihood Increases Next Week
paras: 美元周五(11日)小幅走高，受到消費者通膨報告推升聯準會(Fed)升息預期的提振。但就本周而言，美元變化不大，交易員反而將注意力集中在美國公債殖利率及日元的大幅反彈上。
紐約尾盤，追蹤美元兌六種主要貨幣的美元指數(DXY)0.1%，報99.13。
匯市參與者周五將焦點集中在最新公布的消費者物價指數(CPI)報告。根據美國勞工統計局(BLS)，8月整體CPI與核心CPI月增率分別為0.4%和0.3%，市場原先預期分別為0.4%和0.2%，且兩者均較7月的0.1%和0.2%加快。
以年增率來看，8月整體CPI上升3.4%，與7月持平。核心CPI則從2.5%降至2.4%，兩項數據均符合市場預期。
CPI數據進一步推升聯邦公開市場委員會(FOMC)下周升息25個基點的可能性。根據CME FedWatch工具，通膨數據公布後，市場預期升息25個基點的機率從數據公布前約69%，大幅升至接近87%。
儘管PPI和CPI都是市場密切關注的通膨指標，但FOMC更重視個人消費支出(PCE)物價指數，將其視為主要通膨衡量指標。PPI和CPI中的部分項目會納入PCE計算，而PCE通膨率已連續65個月高於聯準會長期2%的目標。
在8月CPI公布前，市場對升息的預期已逐步升溫。7月時，3位地區聯準會主席對FOMC維持利率不變的決定提出異議，到了8月底，聯準會主席華許(Kevin Warsh)在傑克森霍爾(Jackson Hole)年度央行年會上發表明顯偏鷹的演說，指出潛在通膨趨勢並未改善。
同時，其他經濟指標也進一步提高貨幣政策收緊的可能性，包括上周大幅優於預期的非農就業報告，以及周四公布、顯示整體通膨加速的8月生產者物價指數(PPI)報告。
此外，美國與伊朗局勢升溫導致近期油價大幅上漲，進一步加劇市場對通膨的擔憂，也增加美國民眾加油的負擔。美國柴油價格周四更首次突破每加侖6美元。
美國債券市場尤其反映出市場對升息預期持續升溫的情況。自聯準會7月利率決策前後，美債市場便陷入拋售，尤其是長天期債券跌勢更加明顯。殖利率隨後大幅攀升，推動美國30年期公債殖利率升至近20年高點，也促使美國財政部提高長天期公債的回購規模。
然而，美國財政部出乎市場預期的干預並未達到預期效果。CPI公布後，美債周五大致持續走弱，10年期美債殖利率最新上升3.2個基點至4.976%，對利率更敏感的2年期殖利率則上升8.8個基點至4.638%。
市場普遍認為，CPI數據成為最後一根稻草，使升息預期明確轉向升息。
Macquarie經濟學主管David Doyle表示，「我們的基本預期仍是聯準會下周升息，而CPI數據公布後，我們對這項判斷的信心進一步提高。在我們看來，在8月強勁的就業報告公布後，除非通膨數據出現偏鴿派的意外，否則維持利率不變的可能性就會降低。儘管數據內部細項顯示，月增核心PCE可能沒有那麼強勁，但整體而言仍足以支持升息25個基點。」
日元創5月初來首度連兩周上漲
日元自上周以來一直是外匯市場焦點。日元周五進一步升值，創下5月初以來首次連續兩周上漲。美元兌日元下跌0.5%至153.72，本周累計下跌1.6%。
日元近期大幅反彈，反映市場愈來愈相信日本銀行(BoJ)總裁植田和男(Kazuo Ueda)及政策委員會將於9月18日升息。
東京周五公布，8月企業物價指數(CGPI)年增7.6%，高於市場預期的7.4%，顯示進口成本飆升正直接傳導至日本國內的生產端通膨壓力。
DBS分析師指出，儘管市場普遍預期日本銀行將升息25個基點，但市場真正關注的將是政策制定者是否釋放出「彈性、取決於經濟數據」的政策路徑訊號，而非承諾快速連續升息。
歐元在ECB升息後周線下跌
歐元兌美元下跌0.1%至1.1597美元，本周累計下跌0.2%。
歐元走弱之際，歐洲央行(ECB)周四將主要政策利率上調25個基點。ECB表示，中東衝突導致能源價格上漲，持續帶來價格壓力。
ECB在聲明中警告，衝突仍在「產生通膨壓力」，通膨率預計將在「一段較長時間內」明顯高於2%的目標。
此外，《彭博社》周四報導，知情人士透露，ECB官員預計將進一步升息，最快可能在下個月。

paras_en: The dollar edged higher on Friday (the 11th), buoyed by a consumer‑inflation report that lifted expectations of a Federal Reserve rate hike. Over the week, however, the dollar showed little movement, and traders focused instead on U.S. Treasury yields and a sharp rebound in the yen.
In the New York close, the dollar index (DXY), which tracks the greenback against six major currencies, was up 0.1% at 99.13.

FX market participants on Friday centered on the latest Consumer Price Index (CPI) release. According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics, August’s overall CPI and core CPI rose 0.4% and 0.3% month‑over‑month, respectively, versus market expectations of 0.4% and 0.2%, and both accelerated from July’s 0.1% and 0.2% gains.
On an annual basis, August’s overall CPI increased 3.4%, unchanged from July. Core CPI slipped from 2.5% to 2.4%, with both figures matching market forecasts.

The CPI data further boosted the probability that the Federal Open Market Committee (FOMC) will raise rates by 25 basis points next week. The CME FedWatch tool shows the odds of a 25‑bp hike jumping from roughly 69% before the data to nearly 87% after the release.

Although both the PPI and CPI are closely watched inflation gauges, the FOMC places greater emphasis on the Personal Consumption Expenditures (PCE) price index as its primary inflation measure. Some items from the PPI and CPI feed into the PCE calculation, and the PCE inflation rate has now been above the Fed’s 2% long‑run target for 65 consecutive months.

Even before the August CPI was released, market expectations for a rate hike were warming. In July, three regional Fed presidents voiced dissent against keeping rates unchanged, and by the end of August, Fed Chair Kevin Warsh delivered a decidedly hawkish speech at the Jackson Hole annual central‑bank meeting, noting that underlying inflation trends had not improved.

At the same time, other economic indicators further raised the likelihood of tighter monetary policy, including last week’s non‑farm payrolls that far exceeded expectations and Thursday’s August Producer Price Index (PPI) report, which showed an acceleration in overall inflation.

In addition, heightened tensions between the United States and Iran have pushed oil prices sharply higher, intensifying inflation concerns and increasing the cost of fueling for Americans. U.S. diesel prices broke the $6‑per‑gallon mark for the first time on Thursday.

The U.S. bond market especially reflected the growing rate‑hike expectations. Since the Fed’s July rate decision, Treasury markets entered a sell‑off, with long‑dated bonds falling the most. Yields then surged, lifting the 30‑year Treasury yield to near a 20‑year high and prompting the Treasury to expand its long‑term bond buy‑back program.

However, the Treasury’s unexpected intervention did not achieve the desired effect. After the CPI release, Treasuries continued to weaken on Friday, with the 10‑year yield rising 3.2 basis points to 4.976% and the more rate‑sensitive 2‑year yield climbing 8.8 basis points to 4.638%.
The market broadly views the CPI data as the final straw that turned rate‑hike expectations decisively upward.

Macquarie chief economist David Doyle said, “Our baseline view remains that the Fed will raise rates next week, and the CPI release has increased our confidence in that judgment. In our view, after the strong August jobs report, unless inflation data surprise on the dovish side, the odds of a hold diminish. While some components of the data suggest core PCE may not be as strong, overall it still supports a 25‑bp hike.”
The yen posted its first consecutive two‑week rise since early May.

The yen has been a focal point in the FX market since last week. On Friday it appreciated further, marking the first back‑to‑back weekly gains since early May. The dollar fell 0.5% against the yen to 153.72, down 1.6% for the week.
The yen’s recent sharp rebound reflects growing market belief that Bank of Japan Governor Kazuo Ueda and the policy board will raise rates on September 18.

Tokyo reported on Friday that August’s Corporate Goods Price Index (CGPI) rose 7.6% year‑over‑year, above the 7.4% consensus, indicating that soaring import costs are directly feeding domestic production‑side inflation pressure.

DBS analysts noted that although the market broadly expects a 25‑bp rate hike from the BOJ, the real focus will be on whether policymakers signal a “flexible, data‑dependent” policy path rather than committing to rapid, consecutive hikes.
The euro fell on the weekly chart after the ECB’s rate hike.
The euro slipped 0.1% against the dollar to $1.1597, down 0.2% for the week.

As the euro weakened, the European Central Bank raised its main policy rate by 25 basis points on Thursday. The ECB said Middle‑East conflict‑driven energy price increases continue to exert price pressure.
In its statement, the ECB warned that the conflict is still “creating inflationary pressure,” and that inflation is expected to remain “significantly above the 2% target for a prolonged period.”
Additionally, Bloomberg reported on Thursday that sources said ECB officials anticipate further rate hikes, possibly as early as next month.
